system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Terrestrial vegetated areas worldwide, subject to Landsat acquisition footprints, cloud screening, and valid observations.

data_description.temporal_unit: Irregular scene acquisitions with a nominal 16-day revisit interval per satellite
analytical_capabilities: Vegetation index calculation and vegetation condition assessment
Surface temperature and environmental condition analysis

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Surface reflectance, dimensionless after applying Collection 2 scale factors and offsets; ST_B10 provides surface temperature in Kelvin after calibration.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Apply the Collection 2 scale factors and offsets, mask clouds and cloud shadows using quality assurance bands, and account for sensor-specific band differences when combining Landsat collections.

data_description.data_source: NASA and the United States Geological Survey Landsat program
